name: RejectOrder
description: Reject, decline, or cancel a sales order in the SAP ERP system. Trigger this function when the user requests to reject, deny, or cancel an order.

order_id.description: The unique sales order identifier in SAP (e.g., 'ORD-123456') to be rejected.

reason_code.description: The reason code for the rejection. Must be one of the following: 'PRICE_ISSUE' (pricing discrepancy or incorrect price), 'OUT_OF_STOCK' (item unavailable), or 'OTHER' (any other unlisted reason).
